=INSERT INTO customers (phone_number, full_name, email)
VALUES ('{{ ($json.phone_number || '+1234567890').replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '{{ ($json.full_name || 'Valued Customer').replace(/'/g, "''") }}', NULL)
ON CONFLICT (phone_number) DO UPDATE 
  SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
RETURNING id, phone_number, email, full_name, metadata;

=WITH existing AS (
  SELECT id, customer_id, channel, status, created_at
  FROM conversations
  WHERE customer_id = '{{ $('Find or Upsert Customer').first().json.id }}' AND status = 'active'
  ORDER BY created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO conversations (customer_id, channel, status)
  SELECT '{{ $('Find or Upsert Customer').first().json.id }}', '{{ $('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.channel || 'web' }}', 'active'
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM existing)
  RETURNING id, customer_id, channel, status, created_at
)
SELECT * FROM existing
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM inserted;
